chapters.title: The right side: to the lungs
The left side: to the body

q.prompt: Where does the right ventricle pump blood?
options: To the lungs, through the pulmonary artery
To the body, through the aorta
q.explain: The right side of the heart pumps oxygen-poor blood to the lungs.

q.prompt: “The wall of the left ventricle is thicker than the wall of the right ventricle.”
q.explain: It pumps blood all round the body, which needs a higher pressure.

q.prompt: Which vessel carries oxygen-poor blood AWAY from the heart?
q.explain: It is an artery (away from the heart) but carries oxygen-poor blood to the lungs.

cards.front: Path of oxygen-poor blood through the heart
cards.back: Vena cava → right atrium → tricuspid valve → right ventricle → pulmonary artery → lungs

cards.front: Why is the left ventricle wall thickest?
cards.back: It pumps blood through the aorta to the whole body, which needs the highest pressure.
